title: Project Management
modules: Introduction To Project Planning And Scheduling
The Nature And Purpose Of Project
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to how long it will take to finish an activity."
Duration refers to how long it will take to finish an activity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tangible product but conducting a census is not a tangible product."
A motorcycle is a tangible product but conducting a census is not a tangible product.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very important aspect of project management decisions."
Sourcing finance for projects is a very important aspect of project management decisions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a management tool in the practice of project management."
Network analysis is a management tool in the practice of project management.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) methods used in project appraisal."
The Net Present Value (NPV) method is one of the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) methods used in project appraisal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the final stage in the project cycle."
The project execution stage is the final stage in the project cycle.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those costs which are attributed directly to a job or project."
Direct costs are those costs which are attributed directly to a job or project.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are derived from Grant Charts named after their originator, Henry Grant."
Bar charts are derived from Grant Charts named after their originator, Henry Grant.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of exchanging information between one person or another or between one person and a group of persons."
Communication is the process of exchanging information between one person or another or between one person and a group of persons.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the total cost of a job or project before the addition of a mark-up for the purpose of profit."
Factory cost is the total cost of a job or project before the addition of a mark-up for the purpose of profit.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the listing or display that emerges when major project activities have been estimated, subjected to their logical sequences and timed."
A project plan is the listing or display that emerges when major project activities have been estimated, subjected to their logical sequences and timed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important aspect of materials management."
Stores management is an important aspect of materials management.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a contract whereby one party (the lessee) hires equipment from another party (the lessor) in a way that the lessee uses the equipment without purchasing it."
A lease is a contract whereby one party (the lessee) hires equipment from another party (the lessor) in a way that the lessee uses the equipment without purchasing it.
fib: ______ are those costs which remain virtually unchanged and must continue to be incurred even though the workload might fluctuate between zero and the maximum or installed capacity.
Fixed costs
Fixed costs are those costs which remain virtually unchanged and must continue to be incurred even though the workload might fluctuate between zero and the maximum or installed capacity.
______ is any person (labour) equipment, tool or money that is needed for work on a project.
project resource
A project resource is any person (labour) equipment, tool or money that is needed for work on a project.
______ are the Net Present Value (NPV) method and the Internal Rate of Return (IRR) method.
two methods
The two methods are the Net Present Value (NPV) method and the Internal Rate of Return (IRR) method.
______ is a very crucial aspect of our study since most projects practically involve the setting up of project teams.
Understanding team building
Understanding team building is a very crucial aspect of our study since most projects practically involve the setting up of project teams.
______ can be defined as that rate which equates the present value of cash inflows with the present value of cash outflows of an investment.
Internal Rate of Return (IRR)
Internal Rate of Return
IRR
The Internal Rate of Return (IRR) can be defined as that rate which equates the present value of cash inflows with the present value of cash outflows of an investment.
______ is a method that uses accounting information to measure the profitability of an investment.
Accounting Rate of Return (ARR)
Accounting Rate of Return
ARR
The Accounting Rate of Return (ARR) is a method that uses accounting information to measure the profitability of an investment.
______ is one of the most popular methods of project appraisal.
payback period
The payback period is one of the most popular methods of project appraisal.
______ is a vital function in project management because the supply of materials is very critical to ensuring that there are no delays in the supply of materials to projects.
Purchasing
Purchasing is a vital function in project management because the supply of materials is very critical to ensuring that there are no delays in the supply of materials to projects.
______ is made up of a number of people with different qualities and characteristics.
group
A group is made up of a number of people with different qualities and characteristics.
______ are those projects whose output are tangible and can be seen with the naked eye.
Tangible projects
Tangible projects are those projects whose output are tangible and can be seen with the naked eye.
______ is the first stage of a project cycle.
project idea stage
The project idea stage is the first stage of a project cycle.
______ is a specially constituted work group formed within the organisation and given a special assignment or task.
pure project team
A pure project team is a specially constituted work group formed within the organisation and given a special assignment or task.
______ are those that require commitment of resources but whose output cannot be seen with the naked eye.
Intangible projects
Intangible projects are those that require commitment of resources but whose output cannot be seen with the naked eye.
